evidence: These thin films, deposited at various substrate temperatures, were characterized by measuring optical absorption spectra, X-ray diffractions and X-ray photoelectron spectra. For X-ray diffraction analysis a diffractometer RIGAKU GEIGER FLEX with Cu-K, radiation was used. XPS analysis has been carried out by the photoelectron spectrometer JPS-90SX (JOEL) equipped with a side chamber for the Ar-ion sputtering.
